mission: Zero-score and zero-evidence recovery sweep across S2026, S26, and A16ZSR006 using only native post-level evidence with visible post-level metrics and exact canonical company or founder attribution.

dispositionPolicy.accepted: HTTP-resolved native post URL; public native JSON-LD exposed the post author, publication time, and at least one positive supported post-level metric; author exactly matched a canonical company account or listed founder; no canonical or prior-hunt native URL, normalized platform post ID, or physical post identity match.
dispositionPolicy.duplicate: The native URL or physical platform post identity already exists in a canonical social JSON or a prior source-hunt artifact, even when the existing row is context-only, needs review, or currently graph-invisible.
dispositionPolicy.rejected: Profile/search/homepage only, no resolvable native post URL, no positive visible metric, repost-only, third-party author, identity conflict, or inaccessible native post metadata.
dispositionPolicy.normalization: HTTPS; lowercase host; remove www.; remove query and fragment; trim trailing slash. LinkedIn platformPostId is the decimal activity ID. physicalPostIdentity is linkedin:activity:<platformPostId>.

nativeSurfaces: All 31 exact mapped LinkedIn company profiles in the zero-score cohort were fetched directly.
All 80 exact mapped LinkedIn founder profiles in the zero-score cohort were fetched directly.
Every newly exposed LinkedIn post URL was fetched directly and parsed for public JSON-LD post identity, author, timestamp, body, and interaction counters.

Existing exact mapped X accounts were checked through canonical failures and prior source-hunt ledgers; anonymous access remained blocked or incomplete, so no X row was accepted without native visible metrics.

Existing Product Hunt, Hacker News, GitHub, YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, and website results were rechecked in canonical evidence and prior ledgers for identity and eligibility; profile/search/context-only surfaces were not promoted.
